name: BSP_GuiScreen_ComposeScriptPath
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __thiscall(ECX = a native string holding the script name). Resizes two frame strings and memcpys the literals 'interface/' (00D5CB18, 10 bytes, at 00AC5684) and '.lua' (00CFD2C8, 4 bytes, at 00AC5653), then concatenates name between them, so a GUI page name resolves to interface/<name>.lua. Callers 00AC5770 and 00AC6600, which uses it first for '_Common' (00D5CB64) and then for the page itself before reading the global Lua table 'GuiScreen' (00D5CB20). 00AC5820 builds the same path with '.guiedbak' and has no callers. See docs/GUI_LAYOUT_LOADER.md.
